content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

The document fails the ASSIGN fallback in two independent respects, both in walk-away territory:

1. **§(c) Assignment (p0149)** — blanket bar on our assignment with no affiliate or M&A/successor carve-out, no reasonableness standard on Licensor's consent, and no reciprocal restraint on Licensor (who could assign to a competitor of ours).
2. **Article XX(a) (p0134)** — our Agreement and *all* licenses terminate **automatically** on our Change of Control absent Licensor's officer-level consent, with Licensor deemed to withhold reasonably if it "reasonably believes" its interests would be adversely affected — an unqualified Vendor exit right on our corporate transactions.

The validated redline (ok:true) makes the minimum edits to reach the preferred position: adds the Affiliate/successor carve-out, imposes a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld standard plus a no-competitor limit on Licensor assignment, deletes the cross-reference that would have subordinated the new carve-out to Article XX, and converts the change-of-control termination into a 30-day notice obligation while preserving the CHANGE OF CONTROL definition relied on elsewhere.

Flagged in the rationale but not separately redlined: Article XXII gives Licensor a right of first refusal over our sale or merger — a related constraint on our exit best handled under its own rule.
